unique_predictions.name: Non-monotonic spectral dimension flow
unique_predictions.description: Unlike CDT (monotonic 2→4) or KK (monotonic 4→11), the framework predicts d_S flows 2→peak→4 with a peak at intermediate scales where fractal fine structure is maximally resolved.
unique_predictions.test: Could be measured in analog systems (metamaterial waveguides with designed fractal geometry) or constrained by precision particle physics at multiple energy scales.
unique_predictions.status: Novel prediction — no other framework predicts this

unique_predictions.name: Particle spectrum from dimensional flow profile
unique_predictions.description: The particle mass spectrum should be readable from the shape of the d_S(σ) flow profile. Each bump or feature in the dimensional flow corresponds to a new waveguide channel opening up, and the mass of the associated particle is determined by the scale of that feature.
unique_predictions.test: Compute d_S(σ) on candidate fractal geometries and check whether features in the flow correspond to observed particle masses.
unique_predictions.status: Requires computation on specific fractal models

unique_predictions.name: Three generations from three-fold fractal self-similarity
unique_predictions.description: If the metric field's geometry has 3-fold self-similarity, the d_S(σ) profile should show 3 self-similar features at 3 different scales, each producing one generation of fermions.
unique_predictions.test: Compute d_S(σ) on the Sierpinski gasket and check for 3 self-similar features. Compare their spacing to the generational mass ratios.

unique_predictions.name: Dark energy from dimensional flow at cosmological scales
unique_predictions.description: If the spectral dimension is still flowing slightly at cosmological scales (d_S not exactly 4.000...), this would appear as a scale-dependent vacuum energy — i.e., dynamical dark energy.
unique_predictions.test: DESI measurements of w(z) should show specific features if dimensional flow is ongoing at cosmological scales.
unique_predictions.status: Potentially testable with current DESI data

unique_predictions.name: Mode-dependent cosmological redshift
unique_predictions.description: If spatial and internal dimensions are the same fractal at different scales, different field modes (EM, gravity, neutrinos) probe slightly different effective dimensions. This would cause mode-dependent redshift corrections at cosmological distances.
unique_predictions.test: Multi-messenger astronomy: compare redshifts of EM radiation, gravitational waves, and neutrinos from the same source at high z. Einstein Telescope, LISA, and IceCube could test this.

unique_predictions.name: Fractal waveguide analog experiments
unique_predictions.description: The framework's predictions about dimensional flow, mode selection, and chirality can be tested in engineered metamaterial waveguides with fractal cross-sections.
unique_predictions.test: Build waveguides with Sierpinski-gasket cross-sections. Measure the mode spectrum and compare with fractal Laplacian eigenvalues. Test whether asymmetric fractal geometries produce chiral mode selection.
